kinds.a: smart doorbell · doorbell camera · peephole camera
kinds.d: An internet-connected doorbell with a camera, microphone and motion sensor that shows, records and lets you talk to callers from a phone.

kinds.a: door chime · wireless doorbell · bell push
kinds.d: A push button with a sounder that announces a caller, without a camera; wired to a transformer or a radio-linked wireless kit.
m: DBY-22324UK plug-in and portable twin set

brands.d: Amazon-owned maker of smart doorbells, security cameras and alarm systems, founded as the crowdfunded Doorbot by Jamie Siminoff.
Google's smart-home line (thermostats, smoke alarms, cameras, doorbells) descended from Nest Labs, founded by Tony Fadell and Matt Rogers.
American maker of wireless surveillance cameras and video doorbells, formerly a Netgear brand before its 2018 IPO.
Anker Innovations' smart-home brand, known for video doorbells with local storage and no subscription.
Shenzhen networking company whose Tapo and Kasa brands cover budget smart cameras, plugs and video doorbells.
Lock maker of Assa Abloy (Fortune Brands in North America) that also sells smart locks, alarms and a video doorbell under the Yale Home app.
Swiss-American peripherals maker whose Circle View Doorbell is a HomeKit-only video doorbell.
British doorbell brand selling wired, wireless plug-in, portable and kinetic chime kits, widely stocked by UK DIY chains.
Honeywell Home-branded wired and wireless doorbell kits (the former Friedland range), from basic plug-in chimes to Series 9 MP3 units.

notes: Tier shelf, two kinds kept from old data (k45, k46). Door phone/intercom not included (moved to Home Fixtures per rules). Kind sources updated to retrieved Wikipedia articles (Smart doorbell, Doorbell). Founding years left blank for Eufy/Anker, Yale, Logitech, Byron, Honeywell Home where the retrieved page extract did not state one.
